# Science 2.0

> Science 2.0 is a collaborative open science platform connecting the world's leading scientists with engaged readers through curated research news, expert articles, and community discussion across all scientific disciplines.

Science 2.0 aggregates peer-reviewed research and expert commentary across physical sciences, earth sciences, life sciences, medicine, and social sciences. The platform features content from renowned scientists and contributors, organized by discipline with RSS feeds and topic-specific hubs for easy discovery.

## Key Topics

- Physics
- Space & Astronomy
- Earth Sciences
- Chemistry
- Life Sciences
- Medicine & Health
- Environment & Climate
- Energy & Nanotechnology
- Photonics & Optics
- Research News
- NASA
- Science Articles
- Article Aggregation
- Open Science
- Science Policy

## Core Hub

- [Science 2.0 Homepage](http://www.science20.com): Science 2.0 homepage featuring world's best scientists and smartest readers.

## Physical Sciences

- [Physical Sciences Hub](http://www.science20.com/physical_sciences): Physical sciences hub covering physics, chemistry, astronomy, and space.
- [Physics](http://www.science20.com/physics): Physics section featuring particle physics, Higgs boson, and photonics.
- [Space](http://www.science20.com/space): Space science hub covering astronomy, astrophysics, and space observatories.
- [Chemistry](http://www.science20.com/chemistry): Chemistry section featuring molecular computing and research articles.
- [Applied Physics](http://www.science20.com/applied_physics): Applied physics hub with research news from UC Riverside and universities.
- [Optics](http://www.science20.com/optics): Optics hub featuring quantum optics, photonics, and imaging technology.
- [Aerospace](http://www.science20.com/aerospace): Aerospace section covering space industry, satellites, and earth observation.
- [Physical Sciences Feed](https://www.science20.com/physical_sciences/feed): Physical sciences news feed covering NASA, Mars, and related research.

## Earth Sciences & Environment

- [Earth Sciences Hub](http://www.science20.com/earth_sciences): Earth sciences hub covering environment, energy, climate, and agriculture.
- [Environment](http://www.science20.com/environment): Environment section featuring global warming and sustainability news.
- [Energy](http://www.science20.com/energy): Energy hub covering renewable energy, nanotechnology, and resources.
- [Atmospheric Science](http://www.science20.com/atmospheric): Atmospheric science section with climate research and NASA findings.
- [Earth Sciences Feed](https://www.science20.com/earth_sciences/feed): Earth sciences feed featuring environmental, climate, and tropical research.

## Life Sciences & Medicine

- [Life Sciences Feed](https://www.science20.com/life_sciences/feed): Life sciences feed covering biology, genetics, ecology, and neuroscience.
- [Medicine](https://www.science20.com/medicine/feed): Medicine feed with COVID-19, vaccine research, and public health articles.
- [Social Sciences](https://www.science20.com/social_sciences/feed): Social sciences feed covering anthropology, psychology, and science policy.

## Content & Culture

- [Culture](https://www.science20.com/culture/feed): Culture section RSS feed with science news and blog post aggregation.

## User & Support

- [FAQ](http://www.science20.com/faq): FAQ explaining Science 2.0 concept, collaboration, and open science platform.
- [User Account](http://www.science20.com/user): User account management, login, registration, and contributor signup page.
